summary: Moses asked God to go with His people and to show him His glory. God hid Moses in a rock, passed by, and proclaimed that He is merciful, gracious, and full of love. Moses' face shone.

story_reel.narration: After the golden calf, Moses prayed, 'If Your presence doesn't go with us, don't send us from here.' God answered, 'My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.' Then Moses asked something bold: 'Please show me Your glory.' God said, 'No one can see My face and live. But I will put you in a gap in the rock and cover you with My hand while My glory passes by. Then you will see My back.' So Moses cut two new stone tablets and climbed the mountain. Yahweh came down in a cloud and passed in front of Moses, proclaiming His name: 'Yahweh, Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and full of loving kindness and faithfulness, forgiving sin.' This is how God describes Himself! Moses bowed down and worshiped. God wrote His commandments again on the new tablets. When Moses came down the mountain, his face was shining so brightly from being with God that the people were afraid to come near him. He had to cover his face with a veil. Spending time with God changes us.

scenes.caption: Moses prays
scenes.art_direction: Moses in a tent of meeting, pleading with God inside a pillar of cloud.

scenes.caption: The cleft of the rock
scenes.art_direction: Moses tucked in a crevice of the mountain; a great hand of light covering the opening.

scenes.caption: God's glory passes
scenes.art_direction: A brilliant, golden light sweeping past, with words appearing: Merciful, Gracious, Loving, Faithful, Forgiving.

scenes.caption: New tablets
scenes.art_direction: Moses carrying two fresh stone tablets down the mountain.

scenes.caption: A shining face
scenes.art_direction: Moses' face glowing; people shielding their eyes; Moses putting on a veil.

memory_verse.text: My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, and His presence goes with me.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God described Himself as merciful, gracious, loving, and forgiving. Which of these words about God means the most to you today?

quiz.question: What did God promise when Moses prayed?
quiz.explanation: God said, 'My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.'

quiz.question: Where did God hide Moses when His glory passed by?
options: In a gap in the rock
quiz.explanation: God said, 'I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand.'

quiz.question: What happened to Moses' face after being with God?
quiz.explanation: Moses didn't know that the skin of his face shone because he had been speaking with God.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You are merciful, gracious, and full of love. Thank You that Your presence goes with me. Change me as I spend time with You. Amen.

companion.message: When my brother came down with his face glowing, we were all amazed. Being close to God changes you from the inside out.
